rows.en: I will hear the Riders' dying screams with these very ears, without fail! Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh…
But before that… the combatants who failed shall go to hell! Do it! Gebacondor!
Waaaagh!!
Eeee, eeee!!
…!? Their own combatants?
Looks like he's really steamed. Well, no wonder… We played them perfectly.
And thanks to that, we got these bodies!
Want to try out that power? Let's go!
Nngh… Curse you, Kamen Rider! I'll show you what we revived monsters are really made of! Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh!!
Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh!! Nngh… Curse you, Kamen Rider! You'll pay for this!
To the two of you making it back safe, and to the new Kamen Riders… Cheers!!
Cheers!!
Cheers!!
Takeshi, Hayato… Go start testing the New Cyclones right away! Give it your all.
Yes, sir!
Still, Goro… That was quite the feat, eh?
Not really…

Huh?

Goro's feat? Mr. Tachibana, what do you mean?

What, you didn't notice?

Takeshi and Hayato weren't brainwave-controlled, and it wasn't just their own strength. It was thanks to Goro's psychic powers!
Psychic powers?

Yeah… Just in case, I put the two of them under self-suggestion.

Doctor Death uses powerful hypnosis… so I suggested a strong heart that wouldn't lose to it.
Psychic powers, huh… You can use some handy stuff, Goro.
What, Retsu? You're still here? If you don't head back soon, you'll get fired!
Ah, oh shoot…
Come to think of it, Retsu… You've started working at a riding club, haven't you? Do your best.

Huh?

Goro? Huh, what? What's going on? What do you mean?
Oh, right… Retsu, you work at a riding club now, don't you? Lucky…

…!?

Saburo!!

…!?

Saburo!!
You're not getting away today!
Heh heh heh… Kikaider! This time I'll destroy you completely!

Ugh… damn it! I have to exchange my brain's blood for fresh blood! Ngh, after coming this far…

Kikaider! The next time we meet… I'll take your life, without fail!
Uoooh!!
Joined by the two enhanced Kamen Riders, the heroes, with fresh resolve, each carved into their hearts a vow to stand against the armies of evil…
Defeat Executive Monster Gebacondor and all Shocker Combatants!
Defeat all revived Executive Monsters and Shocker Combatants!
All allies are destroyed, or Hakaider is destroyed
Doctor Death, Ambassador Hell… How goes Shocker's cyborg training center?

Leader, there's no need for concern. The enhancement training of the cyborgs is already proceeding smoothly.

Just one more… If we could borrow the abilities of Tobei Tachibana as a capable trainer, it would be all the more perfect.
I see, as expected of Doctor Death… But how will you make Tobei Tachibana cooperate?

Leader, leave it to me.

I have prepared the Poisoned Water Supply Operation, and Garagaranda is already carrying it out…
Very well… Make sure it succeeds!

Heh heh heh… The two million people who use this river's water for their water supply will die!

Once I release the rattlesnake's deadly venom, this Poisoned Water Supply Operation will be a success!
Hold it!! Shocker monster Garagaranda! I won't let you have your way.
Nngh… Kamen Rider!? How did you learn of my operation?
Someone in Shocker tipped us off about you!
What!? A traitor in Shocker? That's impossible! Gwaaara!
Nngh, who could the traitor be? I can't stay here! I must report to the Leader, gwaaara!

Gugh…

We'll settle this another time! Dealing with the traitor comes first! I must report to the Leader, gwaaara!
I didn't think it was possible… but the information was true?
I didn't think it was possible… but the information was true?
…Who could have tipped me off?
…Who could have tipped me off?
Ngh… Let go! What are you doing? I'm your commander!
Ambassador Hell…
Doctor Death… What… what is the meaning of this?
Ask your own heart!
As your loyal subordinate, I have carried out the Leader's orders…

Silence!

From Garagaranda's report, we have learned that there is a traitor within Shocker who leaked the operation to Kamen Rider.
What did you say!? And you think it's me?

This Poisoned Water Supply Operation was Shocker's top secret!

The only ones who knew of the operation were I, the Leader, and Ambassador Hell, were they not? Ambassador Hell, you are the traitor!

I watched in silence because you claimed you could make Tobei Tachibana cooperate…

but on top of a worthless operation, you betray our Shocker yourself…
No, it wasn't me! Let go!!
This is unseemly, Ambassador Hell!
Lock him up until his execution!
Leader!!
Oh, that's unusual… A picture postcard's come for Takeshi.
So it has. This photo… where in Japan is it?
This is… the Namerikawa Ocean Museum in Chiba Prefecture.
What a beautiful place.
Hongo's a sly one… Is it from some lady doctor of marine biology or something?

…!?

No… It's from the Leader of Shocker.
You're right… Where's this photo from?
A museum? That's so Mr. Hongo.
So that means… it's from a lady doctor of marine biology?

No way!? Could it be his girlfriend?

Ooh, who, who? Let me see, let me seee!!

Ah…
What's wrong, [HERO4]? Is it someone we know?

Yeah, we know them well.

It's the Leader of Shocker!
Wh-what!?

uncertain: U02655: 相当、頭に来てる refers to Doctor Death/Gebacondor killing their own combatants; 'he' used for the (male) Doctor Death
U02710: the Leader names 'I, the Leader, and Ambassador Hell' as the only ones who knew
U02728: Leader of Shocker referred to as 'them' (gender not established)

glyph_suspects.likely: 幹部怪人 / 戦闘員を全て
再生幹部怪人 / 戦闘員を全て
味方が全滅させられた場合
